# Remy 0.9.0 Beta 1
Remy is a focused macOS menu bar companion for Apple Reminders.
## What you can test
- Create, edit, complete, delete and filter Apple Reminders without opening the Reminders app. - Use natural-language dates, times, lists, priorities, recurrence, notes, URLs and locations. - Plan reminders visually in My Day without changing their Apple Reminders due dates. - Opt individual reminders into Intensive Mode for local follow-up notifications and Notch feedback. - Create reminders from selected text through the macOS Services menu.
## Beta refinements
- A dedicated Remy Beta icon makes this build easy to distinguish. - Settings > Lists now scrolls smoothly with a trackpad or mouse wheel. - About can check for signed updates and optionally check automatically each day.
## Before installing
- Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon or Intel. - Requires a beta activation key and an internet connection for the first activation. - This is pre-release software. Keep Apple Reminders available for time-critical tasks.
Read the [installation guide](https://github.com/hibenka/remy-releases/blob/main/INSTALLATION.md), [known limitations](https://github.com/hibenka/remy-releases/blob/main/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md) and [privacy notice](https://github.com/hibenka/remy-releases/blob/main/PRIVACY.md). Request a key or private help through the [support form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd_WUSUm1IOx_NiRY_ImQ70vSM2ksVTHnokpzQ_ag4jqi6W3Q/viewform).
